headline: Frequent Rework on Comment Handling Logic
diagnosis: The recurring theme in the commit messages highlights issues related to handling comments, specifically those involving `# fmt: skip` and `# fmt: off` directives. The code sections dealing with comment parsing and formatting are frequently modified, indicating that they are prone to bugs or edge cases that are not being adequately addressed.
plan: Conduct a thorough review of the comment handling logic, focusing on the ProtoComment class and related functions that process `# fmt: skip` and `# fmt: off` directives.
Identify and document all edge cases that have led to recent crashes and reworks, ensuring that these scenarios are covered in unit tests.
Refactor the comment handling logic to simplify and clarify the code structure, reducing complexity and potential for bugs.
Implement comprehensive unit tests for all identified edge cases to ensure stability and prevent future regressions.
owner_hint: Ownership should be shared among the team to mitigate bus factor risks.
